title: NPDev AI Authoring Submission Manifest
description: The manifest an Author (a non-human agent) MUST submit alongside a model.json change against an existing app. See AI_AUTHORING_CONTRACT-2026-07-31.md Part 6 for the full rationale; empty arrays are meaningful and MUST be present -- a missing key means the Author never looked.

recordKind.description: Contract tag for this document shape.

previousModelSha256.description: SHA-256 of the previous model.json the Author was handed (I1), verbatim, hex-encoded, optionally prefixed 'sha256:'. The Custodian recomputes this from the actual previous model file and refuses on any mismatch (F6 -- the compare-and-swap that prevents two authoring sessions from silently clobbering each other).

previousModelVersion.description: The 'version' field of the previous model.json, as the Author read it.

submittedModelVersion.description: The 'version' field of the submitted model.json. MUST be strictly greater than previousModelVersion (A7).

request.description: One sentence: what the Owner actually asked for.

renames.description: Every concept/field the Author believes was renamed rather than removed. Each entry's 'to' must carry a matching renamedFrom in the submitted model -- the manifest states intent, the model itself carries the mechanism the engine trusts.

concept.description: Required when kind=field; the concept the field belongs to (its CURRENT/submitted name).

deliberateRemovals.description: Every concept/field the Author intentionally deleted, with its data. Each name MUST NOT reappear anywhere in the submitted model (A3).

concept.description: Required when kind=field; the concept the field belonged to (its previous name).

securityChanges.description: Every access.read / access.write / permissionRequirements / invariant / sensitive delta between the previous and submitted models (A9, A10). The Custodian independently detects every such delta and refuses any not listed here.

concept.description: The concept name (or, for a procedure/query permissionRequirements delta, the procedure/query name).

couldNotExpress.description: Every requirement the Author could not express inside the DSL (A12) -- an honest refusal, not an approximation.

unchangedButSuspect.description: Anything the Author noticed looked wrong but did not touch (A6 -- minimal diff discipline; flag it here instead of fixing it unasked).

mergeOutcome.description: S5 (element-granularity authoring merge): present ONLY on a manifest the Custodian itself synthesizes for a MERGED submission (never authored by hand) -- records provenance so a merge is inspectable after the fact: which base it merged from, which two submissions it combined, and which (arrayKey, name) elements came from which side. Optional and additive; a manifest with no merge in its history has no reason to carry this field.
